declared_exclusions.reason: Not run live (LOCAL order). The portal code states it: the upload request carries upload_token, one per chosen file, and prospect.ts and ProspectComposer.tsx re-POST the IDENTICAL body as the poll for a RESOLVING answer (3 s, the server re-sends to the resident at most once per 16 minutes).
